ticket_events_status_change.name: ticket_events_status_change
ticket_events_status_change.value: "ticket_events"."kind" <> 'status' or ("ticket_events"."to_status" is not null and "ticket_events"."from_status" is distinct from "ticket_events"."to_status")

ticket_events_asset_named.name: ticket_events_asset_named
ticket_events_asset_named.value: ("ticket_events"."kind" in ('asset_linked', 'asset_unlinked')) = ("ticket_events"."asset_id" is not null and "ticket_events"."asset_number" is not null)
